text:
The Boring Company is building something far bigger than most people even realize

While everyone is focused on Tesla and SpaceX, Elon Musk is also transforming underground transportation and industrial infrastructure, and the scale of what’s now happening is incredible

The Boring Company is now valued at $23 billion after recently raising another $3 billion in funding

And that funding is helping accelerate something even massive: a new partnership to develop over 150 kilometers of underground infrastructure across the UAE, on top of the existing Dubai Loop project

Just look at what the company has already accomplished in Las Vegas:

• Over 4 MILLION passengers transported
• 14 operational stations
• 68 MILES of tunnels approved for expansion
• 123 stations approved across the planned network
• Targeting 28 operational stations by the end of 2026

And the expansion is already moving beyond Las Vegas

In Nashville, two Prufrock tunnel-boring machines are operating simultaneously, a third is scheduled to begin tunneling later this month, and a fourth is already being built

More than 40 stations are in various stages of planning and design

The company has also signed a new agreement to explore transportation and utility tunnels in Abu Dhabi

And just days ago, its massive 900,000-pound Prufrock-5 machine arrived in San Antonio to prepare for a new underground transportation project designed to improve accessibility

But here's another incredible example of how this technology is already being used inside Tesla's Gigafactory Texas

The Boring Company built an underground tunnel beneath an eight-lane highway to transport finished Cybertrucks directly from the production line to their staging area

Previously, that journey required around 12 minutes using surface roads

Now it takes just 60 SECONDS

That's a 12× improvement in transportation time

And the engineering behind the tunnels is even more impressive

The company has already demonstrated autonomous installation of massive concrete tunnel segments with millimeter precision, while its machines are designed to mine and install tunnel lining continuously

Think about what happens when this technology scales across factories, airports, cities and industrial infrastructure

And this is where the vision gets much bigger

The Boring Company is literally laying the foundation for 3D infrastructure for entire cities, where transportation networks expand across multiple underground levels instead of being limited to surface roads

Las Vegas, Nashville and Dubai are just the beginning

Elon Musk is fundamentally rethinking how cities will be built and how transportation will work at massive scale

And what he's building underground is going to be something far bigger than most people have ever imagined

DeepSeek 发布 V4.1-Flash-1017：做事更快、回答更短，官网和 App 已换新；联网搜索 API 每千次 5 元，11 月 1 日起收费

DeepSeek 发布 V4.1-Flash 的升级版 V4.1-Flash-1017（1017 指 10 月 17 日）。官方说它测试分数更高、完成任务更快、输出更短。输出短，消耗的 token（AI 计费单位，可以理解成文字碎片）就少，同一件事做得更好，也更省钱。

普通用户打开 DeepSeek 官网或 App 用的就是新版。开发者调 API 的模型名还是 deepseek-flash，代码不用改。

这一版主攻从零做完整个项目，演示里它从头做出了小游戏和 3D 模型。官方在 Hugging Face 公布的测试里，进步最大的是让 AI 在命令行里自己敲命令干活，从 31.2 分涨到 42.3 分。和 Anthropic 的 Opus 5 比，几项自动办事的测试它分更高，高难度问答和写完整程序仍然落后。这些分数都是 DeepSeek 自己测的。

另一件事跟开发者的钱包有关：DeepSeek 把自家搜索引擎开放成接口。Search 输入关键词返回网页结果，Fetch 给一个网址把网页内容抓成文字，合起来能让 AI 应用上网查资料。每个接口每 1000 次成功请求收 5 元（英文版标 0.75 美元），失败、没搜到、超时不收钱。

如果你把 DeepSeek API 接进 Claude Code、Codex 或 DeepSeek 自家的编程工具 DeepSeek Harness 当背后的模型，这些工具里 AI 自动发起的搜索和抓网页目前免费，北京时间 11 月 1 日零点（10 月 31 日 16:00 UTC）开始按次收费。

模型同时开源，MIT 协议，允许商用，可在 Hugging Face 和魔搭社区（ModelScope）下载。它有 7630 亿个参数，个人电脑跑不动，主要给企业和云服务商自己部署。

模型下载：https://huggingface.co/deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017
搜索 API 文档：https://api-docs.deepseek.com/zh-cn/guides/search/

text:
Ben Horowitz on the lesson LoudCloud, his early cloud company, taught him about today's AI neoclouds, and why they now face the opposite problem:

"It can end up being like a very dangerous arbitrage business, where you can get upside-down easily. And so if you look at LoudCloud, just as an example, here's a simple thing that happened to us."

"In 1999, bandwidth was $1,500 a megabit. And you couldn't get it. It was very hard to get it. And so you had to get a long-term contract, three years. By 2001, it was $50 a megabit... And if you borrowed money to get it, you're dead."

"That kind of thing is so out of the control of the entrepreneur."

"I think the core dynamic of AI has been working for CoreWeave, though, in that there's a massive shortage, not an overage of supply... Token prices have gone down, but GPU prices have not."

"And by the way, data center space is going up in price because even labor to build data centers is hard. The politics are making it hard to build data centers. So the whole supply chain price is going up and demand is not subsiding."

"Those are very big tailwinds for CoreWeave, despite the fact that the debt markets, kind of independent of them, are tough."

@bhorowitz w/ @chamath on @allinpod

Ali Ghodsi of @Databricks on the four conditions that would have to hold for AI to truly improve itself:

"The next model requires less resources, less GPUs to train... The second condition: the next model takes less time to train as well. Third, accuracy of the model, the intelligence is increasing. And fourth, we can do the former three again and again and again... All at the same time, not just any of them."

"If you just mean that the software is writing itself, we're already there today. Like 90-some percent of the software in Databricks is written by AI. Does it matter if the last few percent is also written by AI? No."

"If you're getting these four conditions, then you might get a speed-up where the next model, let's say, takes half amount of time and half the resources, and it is more intelligent... By the way, I don't even know if that necessarily leads you to superintelligence."

"A lot of people, their definition is just, 'Hey, if I'm not even coding anymore and it's coding itself'... I think they're conflating, 'Hey, what's my value and is it scary for me?' Versus, 'Hey, that then means we'll get that superintelligence that in 2014 was hypothesized by Bostrom.'"
